listing.name: Scuffed Star Citizen Patch (major credit to AccuracyThruVolume)
listing.summary: Since I don't know how to make a real mod, I resorted to just using the existing code AccuracyThruVolume made and altering the assets of his mod to integrate star citizen ships into Starsector.
listing.aiSummary: Integrates Star Citizen ships into the game by replacing assets in an existing faction mod.

description:
Depreciated for standalone version here:

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=34766.msg507543#msg507543

To preface, this patch is something I created initially for myself and I wish to take no credit from the fantastic work of AccuracyThruVolume for making the dependency mod here(one of my favorite mods -Battlefleets of the Gothic Sector): https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=18104.0

if he wishes me to take down this post for any reason, I will do so immediately. I tried DM'ing him and have yet to get a response but I would love to hear his opinion on me using his assets.

Since I don't know how to make a real mod, I resorted to just using the existing code AccuracyThruVolume made and altering the assets of his mod to integrate star citizen ships into Starsector. I made this mod since I read somewhere that it's unlikely a mod for Star Citizen will ever be released so I initially started messing with the sprites for myself and the following patch was created.

I have no set plans to expand upon it and make it into a real mod... if someone wishes to take everything I did here and make it into a real standalone mod, please do so and just provide me a link so I can play it myself.

TL;DR: I stole AccuracyThruVolume assets cause I don't know how to make a mod

The patch in question: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1YuFxcxEFHz5sbA-2RG28PiM1AHY2XzXs/view?usp=sharing

Lore:
the only logical lore I can come up with is that the star citizen ships were from the golden age of technology and the STCs of the blueprint were scattered between imperium and chaos during the heresy.

Hull Specifications: I tried to make all the ships sizes as 1:1 to each other as possible
since I didn't know how to change ship names and was too scared to mess with that, I simply kept the names of the ships they replaced.

Spoiler
Javelin: replaces Despoiler - Chaos
big boi with a lot of forward facing firepower and massive hanger space but expensive to deploy
Spoiler

Idris(not in picture cause I took screenshot before I made Idris): replaces enforcer - Imperium
big gun at the front that takes time to charge but kinda sad if you miss
Spoiler

Polaris: replaces endeavor - Imperium
a lot of missiles but kinda weak firepower. small and nimble for capital ship
Spoiler

Perseus: replaces iconclast - Chaos
tanky af and two big guns. but has a really bad time if flanked. really small and agile for its class
Spoiler

Retaliator: replaces cobra - Imperium
powerful torps but very little in the way of personal protection
Spoiler

Contellation: replaces harbinger bomber - Chaos
expensive for a fighter slot but comes with an array of missiles and decent firepower
Spoiler

Ares spirit: replaces starhawk bomber  - Imperium
big bombs and good all around fighter/bomber, but only comes in pairs
Spoiler

Gladius: replaces swiftdeath interceptor - Chaos
deploys in squadrons of 5 and makes short work of other fighters, but tiny missiles for tiny damage.
Spoiler

How to get them
They spawn/appear in all places chaos/imperium ships would appear

Installation:
1. download and install battlefleet gothic mod: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=18104.0
2. just replace everything in this file with the files of the battlefleet gothic folder (drag and drop).
3. should be good.

compatibility:
-This patch is made for Battlefleets of the Gothic Sector V 0.5.1 . This patch will likely brick if that mod is updated
-I doubt there will be any additional compatibility issues that the original mod won't have since I'm only replacing existing files/attributes.

in conclusion, I initially made this mod for personal use only but I figured I should share this with fellow scam victims of Star Citizen so we all see our beloved ships in fleet sized battles without spending like tens of thousands.

aiDescription: Replaces ships from the Battlefleets of the Gothic Sector mod with Star Citizen vessels. The patch alters existing sprites and attributes to integrate these ships, which spawn in locations where the original faction ships would appear.
